Biancana

Condominium in Surin
HomeNew ProjectsBiancana

Project overview

Four five-storey residential buildings between Surin and Bang Tao beaches, with 343 units on about 12,300 sqm. Construction was reported at about 3% in October 2026.

Units range from 1-bedroom to 3-bedroom penthouses. Prices and availability on request via WhatsApp.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Biancana?

Biancana is a condominium project in Surin, Phuket, developed by Rhom Bho Property PLC (The Title).

What is the starting price of Biancana?

Agent advertised price is ฿5,664,000, last checked 2026-11-14. Prices and availability change, so ask us on WhatsApp for the current figures.

What ownership is offered at Biancana?

Sources list freehold ownership. Always confirm the exact title and conditions with a Thai lawyer before buying; this is general information, not legal advice.

When will Biancana be ready?

Current status: under construction. Dates can change, so please confirm with us.
